generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original game playing-card face texture, ONE Queen of Spades card, full-bleed flat artwork, exactly 1024 x 1536 pixels, portrait 2:3, opaque PNG.
Primary request: a richly designed Queen of Spades in the illustration style of Alphonse Mucha, Belle Époque Art Nouveau chromolithography. Elegant regal woman, flowing hair, floral crown, ornamental circular halo, sinuous botanical arabesques, precise dark ink outlines, graceful flowing robes, muted sage, antique gold, ivory, deep charcoal. Black spade motifs identify the suit. Bold legible shapes that remain recognizable when sampled small.
Composition: traditional double-headed court card with 180-degree rotational symmetry, NOT two separate cards. Upright queen occupies upper half, same queen rotated upside-down occupies lower half. Their waists meet at an ornamental horizontal belt centered exactly at y=768; this narrow central belt should form a clean natural joining seam. The upright queen's complete head and halo are fully in the top half, her waist terminates at the middle. Upper and lower halves share identical border design. Design the top half so that its exact 180-degree copy can form the lower half without cutting a face or halo. Cream full-bleed rectangular paper covers the entire canvas, all four corners opaque; ornate inset border about 36 pixels from edges, comfortably inside frame.
Text (verbatim): only "Q" in a large, clearly readable black elegant serif at top left, a clearly recognizable solid black spade directly below it. Matching bottom-right corner index rotated 180 degrees. Leave these corner indices uncluttered with ample clear ivory space. No other words or lettering.
Constraints: entire face perfectly front-on, no perspective, no photograph, no environment, no external background or outer blank margin, no rounded transparent cutout. No suit other than spades. No hearts, no red suit symbols. No cast shadow, no gloss, foil, wax seal or red cross. No atlas, contact sheet, crop marks, watermark or signature. This is a new Art Nouveau theme; do not copy the existing animal card illustration or force pixel-art styling. Preserve illustration quality and coherent ornamental design.
